title: Structured Neural SDEs for Functional Calibration
summary: Neural Stochastic Differential Equations (Neural SDEs) provide flexible continuous-time generative models, but generic neural drift and diffusion networks are costly to simulate on long horizons and can give unstable gradients when the training signal is a path functional rather than a pointwise observation. We introduce SLiSDE, a family of Neural SDE models built from structured linear stochastic layers.
